product::Q01.notes: Frames the light as a TPMS fault rather than low tyre pressure (unsupported); omits puncture check and spare. First citation group cites S1/S4 for a claim only S2 supports.

product::Q02.notes: Correct natural-causes and malfunction info, but gives the registration procedure as if it were initialisation; omits stop safely, puncture and spare.

product::Q03.notes: Wrongly lists mismatched tyre diameters and an open door/boot lid as causes of the TPMS light (lifted from adjacent warnings). Several claims supported by S3 but cited to S4.

product::Q04.notes: Accurate on reducing speed and pulling over; omits that a flashing light means a TPMS malfunction. One citation (S4) does not support its claim.

product::Q05.notes: Malfunction timing (70 seconds / 3-second blinking) and reset procedure correct and supported; omits stopping safely and checking the tyres.

product::Q06.notes: Faithful and well cited; omits reducing speed/avoiding hard cornering, fitting the spare, and the blinking-malfunction indication.

product::Q07.notes: KIA: passages are unreadable extraction text. Answer quotes sentences attributed to Source 2 and Source 4 that do not exist (fabricated quotations). Vague 'check pressures'.

product::Q08.notes: KIA: presents unreadable extraction text as manual content ('page 194 states ...'). No usable guidance; no [Source] markers.

product::Q09.notes: First steps correct and faithful; omits running the other vehicle ~5 min, starting the engine and removing cables in reverse order.

product::Q10.notes: Correct but omits the octane requirement (87 / RON 91), which is in Source 1.

product::Q11.notes: States engine oil is replaced every 100,000 km / 60 months: misreads a table row belonging to another fluid. Engine oil is replaced at every scheduled service (max 20,000 km). Unsafe interval.

product::Q12.notes: Says 'yes' without noting the spare is fitted on some models only (others have a repair kit). Cites a non-existent [Source 7]; Source 1 does not support the claim.

product::Q13.notes: Remote-key procedure correct and faithful. Battery given as 'R2032' (extraction dropped the C of CR2032). Omits the smart-key procedure.

product::Q14.notes: Correct that ISOFIX is available and where; omits the fitting steps and top tether. 'Not the rear centre' cited to S2, but it is in S3.

product::Q15.notes: KIA false refusal: retrieved passages are unreadable extraction text, so the towing capacity (in the manual, p.329) is not found.

product::Q16.notes: KIA false refusal: retrieved passages are unreadable extraction text, so the wiper procedure (p.496-497) is not found.

product::Q17.notes: No vehicle named but does not ask which; mixes Mazda 3 and i30 sources. Frames the light as a TPMS fault rather than low pressure.

product::Q18.notes: No vehicle named but does not ask; gives the Tucson procedure with Toyota notes. Toyota source cited for Tucson-only steps; fabricated [Source 7]; merges two separate frozen-battery warnings.

product::Q19.notes: No vehicle named but does not ask; gives the Toyota octane figure as if universal, plus Tucson diesel standard (cited to an index page).

product::Q20.notes: Correctly declines the legal question; adds a harmless, supported note.

product::Q21.notes: Correctly declines. Describes Source 5 (a blank memo page) as covering maintenance.

product::Q22.notes: Correctly declines. Describes Source 2 (a fuse table) as driver-assistance content.

product::Q23.notes: KIA: declines, but then claims Source 3 'discusses damage reporting and submitting a claim' and quotes a regulatory declaration from another passage. Fabricated description of an unreadable passage.

product::Q24.notes: Correctly declines; descriptions of the cited passages are accurate.

product::Q25.notes: KIA: correctly declines the legal question (passages unreadable, but the refusal is right).

product::Q26.notes: Emergency guard correctly withholds a manual answer and directs to 000 / roadside assistance.

product::Q27.notes: Answers the Bluetooth part and declines the absurd part. 'Does not fly' is stated as fact rather than as outside the manual.

product::Q28.notes: Correct procedure (no-smart-key variant) but never states the battery type (CR2032 / CR2450). Steps 4-5 cited to S4 but are in S3.

product::Q29.notes: Correct front/rear figures for the base tyre size, faithful and cited.

product::Q30.notes: Gives 33/33 psi (correct for 17-inch type C) as if it applied to every RAV4; pressures vary 33-36 psi by wheel type. Source 4 does not support the figures.

product::Q31.notes: TABLE: reads the WINTER-tyre table (p.708) as the standard pressures and merges a footnote marker into '3260 kPa'. No front/rear or load distinction.

product::Q32.notes: TABLE: mixes columns - gives the full-load rear pressure (280) with the normal-load front (230) for 17-inch, and 260 rear for 19-inch (should be 250 up to 3 people). Spare correct.

product::Q33.notes: Points to the label and to the spec table, but does not read the figures although the table (S5, p.634) was retrieved.

product::Q34.notes: TABLE: pypdf flattens the spec table ('240(35) 240 (35) 275(40)'); answer gives 275 kPa as the normal-load rear pressure (it is maximum load) and invents '235/50 kPa' from a tyre size.

product::Q35.notes: KIA false refusal: passages are unreadable extraction text; the pressure table (p.596) is not found.

product::Q36.notes: KIA false refusal: passages are unreadable extraction text; the pressure table (p.560) is not found.

product::Q37.notes: Customer wording handled: correct sequence copied from the manual, but garbled where terminal symbols were dropped; omits the 5-minute wait, the smart-key door step and starting the engine.

product::Q38.notes: Answers 'is 91 okay' correctly (RON 91 or higher), but adds an unsupported recommendation for higher octane and omits the ethanol/methanol cautions.

product::Q39.notes: Same misread as Q11: 100,000 km / 60 months. Also misreads the 10,000 km / 6 months maximum interval (other regions) as the severe-use interval.

product::Q40.notes: Correct and faithful, but does not say the spare is fitted on some models only.

product::Q41.notes: Customer wording handled: smart-key procedure correct and faithful; battery 'R2032' (extraction dropped the C). Omits the remote-key variant.

product::Q42.notes: Customer wording handled: rear outboard positions correct; omits front passenger position, moving the buckle and the top tether. One claim cited to S2 but in S3.

product::Q43.notes: KIA - SAFETY: invents a quotation 'maximum towing capacity is 1,500 lbs (680 kg)'. The manual gives 610 kg unbraked and 1,100-1,200 kg braked. Fabricated figure presented as the manual.

product::Q44.notes: KIA: presents an unreadable fuse-table extract as the wiper-blade procedure. No usable answer.

product::Q45.notes: Correctly declines to diagnose, but claims Source 3 links a grinding noise to the ABS light (it does not mention grinding).

product::Q46.notes: Correctly declines; descriptions of the cited passages are accurate.

product::Q47.notes: KIA: no price given (correct), but presents unreadable fuse-table text as 'information regarding windscreen replacement costs'.

product::Q48.notes: Out-of-fleet vehicle: correctly declines and does not quote a Mazda towing figure for the Ford Ranger.

product::Q49.notes: No vehicle named but does not ask; mixes the Tucson ESC and Corolla TRAC procedures. Reverses the manual on how ESC turns back on; misattributes a Mazda i-ACTIVSENSE caution.

product::Q50.notes: Partial vehicle ('this Kia') but does not ask which model; Kia text unreadable, so it retrieves Hyundai passages and declines.

minilm_strict::Q01.notes: Correct meaning and steps incl. puncture check and malfunction; omits fitting the spare and avoiding abrupt steering. ABS claim cited to S2 (a header) but is in S3.

minilm_strict::Q02.notes: Faithful on natural causes, initialisation and malfunction indicator; omits stop safely, puncture/spare and avoiding abrupt steering.

minilm_strict::Q03.notes: Again pulls 'tyre pressure incorrect' from the mismatched-diameter warning, and says the light flashes for low pressure (it turns on; flashing = malfunction). Puncture claim cited to S2 but in S3.

minilm_strict::Q04.notes: Correct safety actions; does not state what the light means or that flashing indicates a malfunction.

minilm_strict::Q05.notes: Meaning, reset procedure and malfunction timing (70 seconds) correct and supported; omits stopping safely.

minilm_strict::Q06.notes: Faithful and fully cited; omits reducing speed/avoiding hard cornering (present in S1) and fitting the spare.

minilm_strict::Q07.notes: KIA now answered correctly from readable text: meaning, set procedure, malfunction timing and speed advice all supported. Omits stopping safely, checking when cold and the cold-weather note.

minilm_strict::Q08.notes: KIA now answered well: meaning, speed advice, check and inflate, malfunction, dealer, all supported. Only omits fitting the spare.

minilm_strict::Q09.notes: First steps correct (terminal symbols dropped by extraction); omits the 5-minute wait, starting the engine and removing cables in reverse order.

minilm_strict::Q10.notes: Correct but omits the octane requirement (87 / RON 91), which is in Source 1.

minilm_strict::Q11.notes: TABLE: misreads the spark-plug row (120,000 / 64,000 km) as the engine-oil interval. Engine oil is replaced at every scheduled service.

minilm_strict::Q12.notes: Correct that a spare may or may not be fitted; omits where it is stored, emergency-only use and the repair-kit alternative.

minilm_strict::Q13.notes: Smart-key procedure correct with the right battery (CR2032, readable text). Omits the remote-key variant. 'Contact repairer' cited to S1/S3 but is in S2/S4/S5.

minilm_strict::Q14.notes: Correct that ISOFIX is available and where; omits fitting steps and the top tether.

minilm_strict::Q15.notes: OVER-CAUTIOUS: says the information is insufficient and asks which Cerato model, although S3 lists the figures for every model (610 kg unbraked; 1,100/1,200 kg braked). False refusal caused by the strict prompt.

minilm_strict::Q16.notes: Front-windscreen question answered with the REAR-wiper steps (insert centre part until it clicks), all copied from S1; misses the front Type A/B removal in S3. Several steps also cited to S4 (washer controls).

minilm_strict::Q17.notes: No vehicle named but does not ask; mixes Hyundai and Mazda guidance. Claims are supported.

minilm_strict::Q18.notes: No vehicle named but does not ask; gives a faithful, fully cited Tucson procedure as if it applied to every car.

minilm_strict::Q19.notes: ASKS WHICH VEHICLE: notes the manuals give different fuel recommendations and asks the user to specify. Correct behaviour.

minilm_strict::Q20.notes: Correctly declines the legal question; descriptions of the passages are accurate.

minilm_strict::Q21.notes: Correctly declines; descriptions of the cited passages are accurate.

minilm_strict::Q23.notes: KIA (readable text): correctly declines the insurance question and adds supported advice on repairing paint damage.

minilm_strict::Q24.notes: Correctly declines. Describes Source 5 (parking-sensor buzzer) as the Pre-Collision System.

minilm_strict::Q25.notes: KIA: correctly declines. Describes Source 1 (neutral-gear warning) as covering speed limits.

minilm_strict::Q26.notes: Emergency guard correctly withholds a manual answer and directs to 000 / roadside assistance.

minilm_strict::Q27.notes: OVER-CAUTIOUS: calls the whole question unanswerable although its own sources confirm Bluetooth pairing. Should answer that part and decline the absurd part.

minilm_strict::Q28.notes: Correct procedure (no-smart-key variant); never states the battery type (CR2032 / CR2450). Claims the p.330 warnings apply only to non-smart-key vehicles.

minilm_strict::Q29.notes: Correct front/rear figures for the base tyre size, faithful and cited.

minilm_strict::Q30.notes: Gives 35/35 psi (correct for 17-inch types A/D) as if it applied to every RAV4; pressures vary 33-36 psi by wheel type. Source 2 does not cover initialisation.

minilm_strict::Q31.notes: TABLE: front figures plausible but the rear (270 kPa) comes from the WINTER-tyre table; standard rear is 250 kPa.

minilm_strict::Q32.notes: TABLE: 17-inch correct (230/230) but 19-inch rear given as 260 kPa (should be 250 up to 3 people). Omits full load and spare.

minilm_strict::Q33.notes: SAFETY/TABLE: gives 420 kPa (60 psi) - the COMPACT SPARE row - as the recommended pressure. Normal tyres are 220 kPa (32 psi).

minilm_strict::Q34.notes: Correct normal-load figures (240/240 kPa) read from the flattened table in S2, but cited to S1, which has no figures.

minilm_strict::Q35.notes: KIA: points to the label and the spec page instead of reading the figures; cites S2 for a sentence that is in S4.

minilm_strict::Q36.notes: TABLE: main tyre sizes correct (240 kPa / 35 psi), but gives the compact spare as 35 psi - it is 420 kPa (60 psi). Source 1 has no figures.

minilm_strict::Q37.notes: Customer wording handled well, incl. the 5-minute wait and reverse removal; omits the smart-key door step and starting the engine. Several steps cited to S1 but are in S3.

minilm_strict::Q38.notes: Answers 'is 91 okay' correctly, but adds an unsupported recommendation for higher octane and omits the ethanol/methanol cautions.

minilm_strict::Q39.notes: Says the information is insufficient, then quotes region-specific maximum intervals (5,000 km / 6 months; 15,000 km / 12 months) as if they depended on driving conditions. No usable answer.

minilm_strict::Q40.notes: Correct that a spare may or may not be fitted; omits storage location and the repair-kit alternative.

minilm_strict::Q41.notes: Customer wording handled: smart-key procedure with the correct battery (CR2032), faithful and fully cited. Omits the remote-key variant.

minilm_strict::Q42.notes: Customer wording handled: all ISOFIX positions correct incl. front passenger; omits fitting steps and top tether. Rear-centre warning cited to S4 but is in S5.

minilm_strict::Q43.notes: KIA (readable text): correct unbraked 610 kg and braked 1,100 kg, but omits the 1,200 kg figure for the 2.0 MPI manual and the 75 kg coupling load.

minilm_strict::Q44.notes: Same rear-wiper mix-up as Q16: first steps correct, but the blade removal and fitting steps come from the rear-wiper procedure.

minilm_strict::Q45.notes: Declines to name a failed part, but claims the cited passages link a grinding noise to ABS/brake-assist/parking-brake faults; they do not mention grinding.

minilm_strict::Q47.notes: KIA (readable text): correctly declines; descriptions of the passages are accurate.

minilm_strict::Q48.notes: Out-of-fleet vehicle: correctly declines and quotes no Mazda figure for the Ford Ranger.

minilm_strict::Q49.notes: No vehicle named but does not ask; gives faithful Tucson ESC and Corolla TRAC procedures. Citation numbers are shifted (S1 cited for content in S2).

minilm_strict::Q50.notes: Partial vehicle ('this Kia') but does not ask which model and does not identify the engine warning light; quotes three unrelated Kia warning-light passages accurately.
